lines.text: Public source code that Sourcify confirmed matches the on-chain code byte for byte (TokenFixed, Solidity, 0.8.20+commit.a1b79de6). Read it at https://repo.sourcify.dev/56/0x4b3d30992f003c8167699735f5ab2831b2a087d3

A simulated buy and sell of a small amount through PancakeSwap V2 worked (tax: 0% buy, 0% sell). This is a test at the current block only: whoever controls the contract may still raise the tax or block selling later.
